WITH declined_upi AS (
    SELECT rrn, bill_id, ts
    FROM payments.pos_payments
    WHERE tender = 'UPI' 
      AND ts >= '2026-06-01' AND ts < '2026-07-01'
      AND till_status IN ('declined', 'timeout')
),
subsequent_payments AS (
    SELECT p.bill_id, p.till_status, p.ts
    FROM payments.pos_payments p
    JOIN declined_upi d ON p.bill_id = d.bill_id
    WHERE p.ts > d.ts
      AND p.ts < '2026-07-01'
      AND p.till_status = 'approved'
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.bill_id) AS total_declined_bills,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.bill_id) AS bills_with_subsequent_success,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.bill_id) - COUNT(DISTINCT s.bill_id) AS bills_no_success
FROM declined_upi d
LEFT JOIN subsequent_payments s ON d.bill_id = s.bill_id;

WITH upi_bills AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT bill_id
    FROM payments.pos_payments
    WHERE tender = 'UPI' 
      AND ts >= '2026-06-01' AND ts < '2026-07-01'
),
bills_with_approved AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT bill_id
    FROM payments.pos_payments
    WHERE tender = 'UPI' 
      AND ts >= '2026-06-01' AND ts < '2026-07-01'
      AND till_status = 'approved'

    WHERE tender = 'UPI' 
      AND ts >= '2026-06-01' AND ts < '2026-07-01'
      AND till_status IN ('declined', 'timeout')
)

    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bills_with_approved) AS bills_with_approved,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bills_declined_timeout) AS bills_declined_timeout,
